Eigenlayer is a restaking protocol built on Ethereum smart contracts. Eigenlayer allows staked ETH and liquid staking tokens to be reused to secure additional services. Eigenlayer runs on the public Ethereum blockchain.

Ethereum Name Service maps human-readable names ending in .eth to wallet addresses. Ethereum Name Service registers domain names as non-fungible tokens. Ethereum Name Service runs on public Ethereum smart contracts.

Opensea is an NFT marketplace for buying and selling digital assets. Opensea supports trading across multiple blockchains. Opensea uses the Seaport smart contract protocol to execute trade orders.
